deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 39 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Model Part Number\""

original_test_intent: Validate each Type 39 Model Part Number as the correct OEM/orderable PSU part identity—not Device Name or Revision Level—and verify stable reporting after reboot.
original_method: Resolve every Model Part Number string reference, bind the exact value to stable PSU/FRU identity, compare using an approved OEM/alternate-part alias map and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies authoritative part/alternate mappings and approves reboot; the read-only identity comparison is automated.
required_inputs: Expected OEM/orderable part number per supply identity
Approved alternate/replacement part and normalization policy
Explicit separation from Device Name, Manufacturer and Revision Level
Type 39 parser, read-only FRU inventory and reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Do not remove or swap a supply to read its label.
Validate and preserve the exact string reference before normalization.
Use only owner-approved alternate-part equivalences; do not fuzzy-match model families.
Stop on power/management loss and do not auto-retry reboot.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve each Model Part Number index, bind to stable PSU identity, compare exact/approved-alias values with read-only inventory and diff across reboot.
Report dangling, blank, duplicated, wrong-field, unmatched or drifting values without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact/alternate part map, field semantics and reboot plan.
Decide replacement-part compatibility exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep omits raw index, record identity and legitimate replacement/OEM alias rules.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive all raw/decoded Type 39 and emit supply identity, string index, exact part value, approved alias mapping and pre/post comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Model Part Number scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no physical validation is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate each raw string reference and compare the exact OEM part against a finite owner-approved original/replacement equivalence map for the same PSU identity across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Model Part Number definition plus approved PSU BOM/FRU data.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable ownership, raw reference validation and controlled replacement-part aliasing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong-field strings, invalid references and unsupported family-level substitutions.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved BOM/FRU part and replacement map.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A compatible replacement may legitimately differ from the nominal BOM; only the approved equivalence list resolves that difference.

project_override_considerations: Projects may accept alternate qualified PSU part numbers, but must document exact equivalences and retain the observed firmware value.
expected_evidence: Approved PSU part/BOM and alternate map
Pre-reboot Type 39 handles, raw indices and exact Model Part Number strings
Per-supply FRU/inventory identity and exact/alias result
Statement that no PSU was manipulated
Approved reboot/health record and post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Model Part Number is a defined Type 39 string field; part aliases are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: String, identity and finite alias comparison are fully automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw reference, stable ownership and orderable-part alias semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its identity safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates BOM/reboot readiness and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents confusing model/part identity with Device Name or Revision Level and avoids unsafe physical label checks.
independent_technical_reasoning: This field represents an orderable part identity; correctness is an exact or explicitly aliased relation to the installed PSU/FRU, not a generic non-empty model-like string.
